msg: First it is better to be quick and not miss a go, than to spend too much time deciding. The numbers are not consistent. So if you notice a particular gnome is getting low points then change your choice to the other gnome. If you are consistently getting less than 3 mushrooms change your answer and see if that helps. If you are getting high number of mushrooms with a particular gnome stick with it for a turns until it becomes low. I found the pink/brown choice was independent of the purple/green choice. So sometimes tall hat for brown was scoring high alongside short green hat. So try to keep in mind which colour for each choice is scoring highly. Try not to worry too much, don't get frustrated if you hit a few low scores in a row.
